rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Firebase MCP server provides a standardized interface for AI assistants to interact with Firebase services including Authentication, Firestore, and Storage. Built by Gannon Hall, this TypeScript implementation enables LLM clients to perform user management, document database operations, and file storage tasks through a consistent set of MCP tools. Particularly useful for developers building AI-powered applications that require seamless integration with Firebase's backend services.
